meta.title: Approvals on Master-Data Creation: not available on the Growth plan
gaps: Observe or configure Approvals on Master-Data Creation for user, item, and product creation.
Compare the capability between a Growth-plan tenant and an Enterprise-plan tenant using the same tenant-admin role.
Verify that the lower-plan capability is refused or absent and that the Enterprise capability is available.
